hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: Where the Red Sea meets a world of refined experiences
hero.introText: Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina is redefining the maritime experience in Saudi Arabia, inspiring both seasoned sailors and watersports newcomers to explore the endless possibilities of the open sea.
imageAlts: Dining table set on the deck of a yacht
A crew member looking at the yachts in the marina

heritage.title: Drawing from the Kingdom’s rich maritime heritage
heritage.text: For centuries Jeddah has been a gateway to the Red Sea. Jeddah Yacht Club & Marina carries that story forward: it opened in 2021 for the Formula 1 race on the Jeddah Corniche and is part of the Kingdom’s Vision 2030.

items.question: What courses are available at the Academy?
items.answer: The Academy runs RYA-accredited sailing, powerboating and other watersports courses for children and adults, at every skill level.

items.question: Do I need prior experience to join a course?
items.answer: No. Our beginner courses start from scratch, and there are courses for every level after that.

items.question: How can I make a reservation at The Jeddah EDITION?
items.answer: You can book directly on The Jeddah EDITION’s website, or contact us and our team will help you with your booking.

items.question: What amenities are available at the hotel?
items.answer: The hotel has 63 luxury rooms, a spa, a gym and restaurants by a renowned chef.

items.question: What size yachts can the Marina accommodate?
items.answer: The Marina welcomes yachts and superyachts of up to 120 metres.

items.question: What services are available at the Marina?
items.answer: Berth holders enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, round-the-clock security, fuelling and a personal concierge service.

items.question: How can I join the Yacht Club?
items.answer: Send us a message through the contact form. Our team will share the membership details and can arrange a tour of the Marina.

items.question: What benefits come with Yacht Club membership?
items.answer: Members are invited to exclusive events and get priority booking at the hotel and Marina, discounts at the restaurants and access to Academy courses.
